name: Goodberry
summary: Bonus Action to eat (or feed to a creature within 5 ft): regain 1 Hit Point and a day's nourishment. Made by Goodberry; they lose their potency after 24 hours.
text: A berry conjured by the Goodberry spell. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one, or feed one to a creature within 5 feet, which regains 1 Hit Point; one berry is enough food for a day. Uneaten berries lose their potency 24 hours after the spell was cast.
